app.installIosBody: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

access.openingFloatHint: Cash left in the drawer for change at the start of the shift.
access.pairHint: Enter the code generated in the company app.
access.pairWhere: Generate the code under Settings → Point of Sale → Terminals in the ISPC Fácil app. It is valid for 15 minutes.
access.noStaff: There are no staff yet. Create them under Settings → Point of Sale → Staff.
access.grace: The subscription has expired. The POS keeps selling until {date}. Renew the plan to avoid stopping.

authorize.title: Manager authorisation
authorize.cancel: Cancelling invoice-receipt {number} needs a manager PIN.
authorize.discount: This needs a manager PIN (e.g. a discount above your limit).
authorize.refund: Returning items from {number} needs a manager PIN.
authorize.cashMovement: Cash movements need a manager PIN.
authorize.difference: The till difference needs a manager PIN.
authorize.voidLine: Removing items already sent needs a manager PIN.

terminal.noCatalog: There are no POS products yet. Set them up under Settings → Point of Sale → Products.

cart.title: Current sale
cart.emptyHint: Tap a product to add it.
cart.resize: Drag to adjust the width (double-click resets)

tables.sent: Table {table} order sent to the kitchen/bar
tables.none: There are no tables yet. Create them under Settings → Point of Sale → Tables.
tables.cancelMessage: Items have already been sent to the kitchen/bar. Give the reason.
tables.voidMessage: This item has already been sent. The kitchen/bar gets a void ticket.
tables.waiterHint: Send the order to the kitchen/bar. Payment is taken at the till.

history.cancelMessage: The invoice-receipt is cancelled, the amount is refunded from the till and quantities go back to stock. Only possible on the same day.

receipt.title: Sale completed
receipt.taxNote: VAT not charged: taxpayer under ISPC.

movement.hint: It is recorded in the till session and counted at closing.

close.title: Close till no. {number}

tablesOpen.one: There is {count} open table. Charge or cancel it before closing.
tablesOpen.other: There are {count} open tables. Charge or cancel them before closing.

close.simulated: Includes {amount} in simulated mobile payments (testing phase).
close.blindHint: Counted: {amount}. The expected amount is checked by the manager.
close.notesRequired: The difference is above the tolerance: write the reason. A manager will have to authorise with their PIN.

display.openedBody: Drag the window to the second monitor and double-click for full screen.
display.confirmOnPhone: Confirm the {method} payment on your phone

offline.body: Documents cannot be issued without internet. The cart is kept; try again when the network is back.

discount.title: Discount
discount.hint: Applies to the total. Above your limit, a manager PIN is requested on charging.
discount.label: Discount

split.hint: Type the amount (or leave the remainder) and tap the payment method.
split.oneCash: Cash goes in once; change the amount of that part.
split.mobileKept: A confirmed mobile payment cannot be removed: complete the sale.
split.billHint: Choose what this person pays now. The rest stays on the table for the next invoice-receipt.
split.billActive: Charging part of the bill ({amount} stays on the table)

refund.title: Refund
refund.subtitle: Choose what the customer returns from sale {number}.

unpair.title: Unpair the device?
unpair.message: The device will no longer be linked to the terminal. A new code is needed to use it again.

client.title: Customer with NUIT
client.hint: The invoice-receipt is issued to the customer. Without a NUIT it goes to the walk-in customer.
client.search: Search by name, NUIT or phone
client.name: Name

mobile.simulationHint: Testing phase: the payment is simulated and confirms on its own in seconds. Numbers ending in 0000 fail.
mobile.waiting: Waiting for confirmation on the customer's phone…
mobile.checkoutHint: On charging, the payment is requested on the customer's phone; the invoice-receipt is issued only after confirmation.
